_readme: One entry per audience page at /for/{slug}/ (src/for/audience.njk), also the hub's "Who it's for" row. status: "live" builds the full page; "coming-soon" builds a waitlist page and shows a Coming soon card on the hub. Editions land on a page when any of their Substack tags is in substackTags (tag them on Substack as usual). Blog posts land when any frontmatter tag is in blogTags, or their slug is in posts. exams (codes from exams.json), kits (titles from brainbyte.kits) and tracks (slugs from brainbyte.tracks) pick the products shown. icon: an ico() glyph; color: an .ico3d colour.
